'''Kateri Nepvue''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]]. 

==History==
She was raised to the shawl twenty years ago.{{Ref/book|13|5}}

She was a prodigious reader.

She had no Warder.

==Activities==
It was unknown whether she sided with Elaida, the Rebels or remained neutral during the [[White Tower Schism]].

She did not heed Egwene's advice to remain alert and refrain from being alone due to recent Aes Sedai murders in the Tower. 

She was the fourth sister murdered and was killed while reading alone in a small reading room.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kateri Nepvue}} 

The Aes Sedai thought the murders to be the work of the [[Black Ajah]], but [[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]] doubts that hypothesis as he thinks the Black Ajah would be unlikely to be so secret about it or target so randomly and there is no sign that [[Traveling]] or the One Power was used.{{Ref/book|13|5}} Egwene later shares her suspicions that it was [[Mesaana]], although Gawyn's objections still hold in that case.

It was later discovered to be the work of a [[Bloodknife]].

==Trivia==
The name of the character comes from [http://www.tor.com/community/users/katenepveu Kate Nepveu]. She wrote the [http://www.tor.com/blogs/2009/02/lord-of-the-rings-re-read-index Lord of the Rings Re-Read] from Tor.com around the time Towers of Midnight was being written.
